``` This HTML code provides a basic structure for a CS:GO website, including a header with a navigation menu, a hero section, news articles, upcoming tournaments, a community section, and a footer. You can customize the content and styling to fit your specific needs. The `styles.css` file referenced in the `` section should contain the CSS styles for your website. The `script.js` file referenced at the end of the `` section can contain any JavaScript functionality you might want to add to your website. Feel free to modify this code as needed to create your own CS:GO website.
